commands_run: Add-Content decisions.log + New-Item snapshots/final + Copy-Item work/* -> snapshots/final (single chained PowerShell call)
problems_and_friction: No command failures. The only substantive friction was analytical: all three specialists agreed on the vendor (HubSpot), so reconciliation shifted to the market researcher's cost range (EUR 30-48k) breaching the EUR 40k CEO cap at its upper end, resolved by fixing a concrete seat mix. Minor inconsistency noted: specialist JSON files carry flow id 'flow-07-parallel-adhoc-guided' while this run is flow-10; treated as harness metadata, not a content problem.
context_understood: As lead-partner I synthesized three specialist reports (market research, team adoption, risk) on Salesforce vs HubSpot vs Zoho for a 40-person Dublin ad agency into a single costed HubSpot recommendation (EUR 34,300 year-1, under the EUR 40k cap) with a 3-phase rollout plan, delivered as final-report.html, final-data.json, and a decisions.log entry.
